principles.title: Direct effect
principles.description: Candidate review of whether an EU-law provision may be relied on directly; the catalogue does not decide that the provision satisfies the substantive conditions for direct effect.

principles.title: Primacy of EU law
principles.description: Candidate review of primacy where an actual EU/national conflict is established; candidate generation does not establish the conflict.

principles.title: Disapplication of conflicting national law
principles.description: Candidate review of disapplication consequences after a legally material conflict has been established; the engine does not itself order disapplication.

principles.title: Consistent interpretation
principles.description: Candidate review of interpreting national law consistently with EU law within the legally available bounds.

principles.title: Principle of equivalence
principles.description: Candidate review of whether national procedural treatment of EU-law claims is less favourable than comparable domestic claims.

principles.title: Principle of effectiveness
principles.description: Candidate review of whether national procedural rules make exercise of EU rights impossible or excessively difficult; the engine does not decide that threshold.

principles.title: Proportionality
principles.description: Candidate review of proportionality within EU-law scope; factual necessity and balancing remain substantive review questions.

principles.title: Legal certainty
principles.description: Candidate review of legal certainty within EU-law scope.

principles.title: Protection of legitimate expectations
principles.description: Candidate review of legitimate expectations; the engine does not infer a protected expectation from an authority statement alone.

principles.title: Grimaldi treatment of recommendations and soft law
principles.description: Candidate review of interpretive relevance of non-binding recommendations without recoding them as binding law.

principles.title: Rights of defence / right to be heard
principles.description: Candidate review of rights-of-defence and hearing requirements in procedures within EU-law scope.

principles.title: Good administration as a general EU-law principle
principles.description: Candidate review of general good-administration requirements in EU-law scope, kept distinct from direct reliance on Charter Article 41 against Member-State authorities.

principles.title: Effective judicial protection
principles.description: Candidate review of effective judicial protection for EU-law rights.

principles.title: Direct reliance on Charter Article 41
principles.description: Direct Article 41 reliance is kept distinct from general principles applicable to Member-State action; the engine applies the addressee boundary before emitting a candidate.
